title: Surgical extrusion with the Seif surgical extrusion protocol: Up to seven-year outcomes in 201 consecutive treatments
html: Teeth deemed nonrestorable because of inadequate ferrule and extensive structural loss, often from deep caries, fractures, or resorptive defects, are routinely planned for extraction and implant placement. Long-term clinical outcome data for a standardized surgical extrusion workflow designed to regain restorability while maintaining biologic stability are limited.
